items.title: Buddy Tate interviewed by Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 3, 1995

ctx.x: They carried Red Rodney down south and they couldn’t carry him down south, so they called him “The Albino” so they could take him down south with this black band. And so they called it “Albino Red.”
See now we’re getting in to [sounds like] Otto King’s world.
